smzfb7k1ft.name: h1
smzfb7k1ft.text: A design tool where you and your AI agent draw together.

6lvkih5opk.text: Open a canvas in your browser. Your agent, Claude Code or any other that speaks MCP, creates screens, components and diagrams on it while you watch, fix things by hand and undo anything.

0w1pcweztk.text: Ask in plain words and watch it appear on the canvas.

iumpzr86ml.text: Build a screen once, turn its parts into components and reuse them as instances.

a4lvzskkf0.text: Boxes, decisions, sticky notes and arrows that follow the shapes when you move them.

pw8vkvk9tr.text: Design tokens switch a whole design between themes in one go.

ro77v3lkym.fontFamily: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

n4nnuzyfjm.text: Export any frame as HTML, a React component or SVG.

j28x62fcxn.text: Each connected agent has its own cursor, name and color on the canvas.

753l9h75h3.text: You and the agent share one history, so nothing either of you did is lost.

jldpr8b6zq.text: Press I, click a spot and leave a note. The agent picks it up and answers there.

ladhm672xf.text: Before it tells you it is done, the agent takes a screenshot and runs the same checks a careful designer would.

zxlh4flgg0.text: Uma ferramenta de design em que você e o seu agente de IA desenham juntos.

eqgaqr594a.text: Abra um canvas no navegador. O seu agente, o Claude Code ou qualquer outro que fale MCP, cria telas, componentes e diagramas nele enquanto você acompanha, ajusta com as próprias mãos e desfaz o que quiser.

i3b2fz9pnf.text: Sem conta, sem limite de uso

499ucaqqws.name: h2
499ucaqqws.text: O que o seu agente consegue fazer

unwhoy2h6a.text: Peça com palavras simples e veja aparecer no canvas.

30su87ld0f.text: Monte uma tela uma vez, transforme partes dela em componentes e reuse como instâncias.

p6hlw96key.text: Aperte I, clique num ponto e deixe um recado. O agente pega e responde ali mesmo.

nyc2xxsp4i.text: Antes de dizer que terminou, o agente tira um screenshot e roda as mesmas checagens que um designer cuidadoso faria.
